comment: Object A5 starts animation A0 (+0 anim, +4 speed, +6 flags, +8 position, +7 variant)

name: anim_advance
comment: Advances object A5 animation by D0 elapsed ticks (8.8 position, loop / ping-pong / stop modes); frame index to +$A

name: draw_anim_object
comment: Draws animation object A5 at D0/D1 (screen pixels; camera A1 subtracted, +$80), depth D2, attr XOR D3

name: anim_hotspot
comment: Hotspot D0 of animation object A5's current frame (variant flips applied)

name: map_copy
comment: Copies a rectangle of name-table words: A0 source, D0 row bytes, D1 VRAM, D2 dest stride, D3 source stride, D4 rows (DMA per row)

name: ring_take_long
comment: Replay ring: a long from the read offset

name: ring_take_word
comment: Replay ring: a word from the read offset (nothing when used = 0)

name: to_sprite_coords
comment: D0/D1 minus camera A5 (+4/+6) plus $80

name: dma_queue_vram
comment: Queues a DMA to VRAM: A0 source, D0 bytes, D1 VRAM address; drained in VBlank

name: dma_queue_wait
comment: Waits until the DMA queue is empty ($FFD898)

name: vram_write_now
comment: Writes D0 bytes from A0 to VRAM D1 through the data port at once (no DMA)

name: fade_colour_start
comment: One colour's fade towards D0 over D1 ticks: step = $10000 / D1 with the remainder as the start, so it ends after exactly D1 ticks (D1 < 2: 1 tick)

name: fade_line_out
comment: Fades line D2 to black over D1 ticks

name: fade_in_start
comment: Start fading towards the palette at A0 (D1 = colours?, D2 = ?); stepped from VBlank

name: fade_colour_to
comment: Fades CRAM colour D2 to D0 over D1 ticks

name: fade_out_start
comment: Start fading to black; stepped from VBlank

name: fade_vblank
comment: VBlank: steps every fading colour (16-bit progress, per-component interpolation) and marks CRAM dirty

name: fade_busy
comment: Non-zero while a fade is running (callers busy-wait on it)

name: font_glyph
comment: A0 = glyph piece for character D0 in font A5 (0 when missing)

name: glyph_width
comment: Width in cells of character D0 in font A5 (space: +2)

name: phase_glyph_width
comment: a printable character's width in font's cells (0 if the font has no glyph for it)

name: text_width
comment: Width in cells of the 0-terminated string A0 in font A5

name: draw_glyph
comment: Draws character D0 of font A5 into a plane at D1/D2: caches its tiles ($150C6) and writes the cells ($14656)

name: draw_text
comment: Draws zero-terminated string A0 with font A5 into a plane (cells), D1/D2 position, D3 attributes

name: phase_plane_b
comment: shown at (x, y) (the map is as wide as the plane: the cells stay), the scroll buffers

name: plane_draw_map
comment: Draws a rectangle of map A1 (width at -4(A1)) into the wrapping plane A5; the rink streams rows through it

name: sprite_cache_now
comment: Sprite tile cache (D0 tile word = ROM address / 32, D1 count) writing tiles at once ($148B0)

name: sprite_cache
comment: Sprite tile cache: VRAM slot for D0 tile word (ROM address / 32), D1 tiles; uploads through the DMA queue when not cached

name: rink_oscillator
comment: o's value at the live tick (`divu` overflow kept as the 68000 leaves it: the dividend unchanged)

name: motion_axis
comment: One axis of a motion object: position (24.8) += velocity * D0 (+ acceleration); with friction D2 the exact decay

name: motion_step
comment: Advances motion object A5 (x, y, z) by D0 ticks with parameters A0 (8 ticks at a time)

name: motion_init
comment: Motion object A5 position = D0, D1, D2 (pixels), velocity 0

name: motion_position
comment: Motion object A5 position in pixels -> D0, D1, D2

name: velocity_polar
comment: (speed, angle) of o's velocity

name: dist_angle_to_point
comment: (distance, angle) from o's position (px) to (x, y)

name: collide_momentum
comment: momentum exchange between a and b (masses ma, mb; restitution word rest): the relative velocity's normal component (doubled, scaled by 1/2 + rest/65536) split by the masses

name: motion_params
comment: Motion parameters A5 (friction tables from D0-D3)

name: clamp_point
comment: D0 to 0..D2, D1 to 0..D3 (max is reached with >=)

name: rng_seed
comment: D0!=0: state=D0. D0=0: state = VDP status<<16 | HV counter, then 32 x rng_next

name: rng_advance
comment: Calls rng_next D0 times

name: rng_next
comment: state = step(state) for the 32-bit state at (A5); returns it in D0. See docs/re/rng.md

name: rng_range
comment: D0=lo, D1=hi -> ((step & $FFFF) * (hi-lo+1)) >> 16 + lo

name: anim_frame_address
comment: Animation A5, variant D4, frame D5 -> frame address A5, variant flips XORed into D3 bits 3-4

name: draw_anim_frame
comment: $1563E then draw_frame

name: sprite_list_reset
comment: Empties the sprite list (count 1, head entry 0)

name: add_sprite_piece
comment: Adds piece A5 (x, y, size, attr, tile word) to the sprite list at D0/D1 (flips D3 mirror the position), depth-sorted by D2

name: sprite_list_upload
comment: Queues the sprite list ($FFE164, count $FFE524) to the VDP sprite table (the label used to sit at $157C8, its rts)

name: text_box_init
comment: Text box A5: plane A0, font A1, x, y, w, h D0-D3, line spacing D4; cursor home

name: text_box_home
comment: Text box A5: cursor to the top left

name: text_box_write
comment: Text box A5: string A0 with attr D3 - word wrap, space = font +2, $0A new line, stops below the box

name: text_box_fill
comment: Text box A5: fills its rectangle with word D0

name: picture_load
comment: Loads the tiles of picture A5 (tiles.l, VRAM base.w, count.w) by DMA and reserves the slots

name: picture_free
comment: Frees the VRAM of picture A5

name: z80_upload_data
comment: Copies D0 bytes from A1 into Z80 RAM after the driver; resets 68k-side channel structs at $FFE78E

name: z80_load_driver
comment: Resets the Z80 and copies the sound driver blob ($15C90: length word + code) to Z80 RAM; clears $FFE6B0

name: sound_init
comment: z80_load_driver, $18706, then $15C14
